use_case: Generative AI assistant add-on to the productivity suite (SYS-10), used by the owner to draft and summarize mail and documents for all three LLCs
vendor_or_model: Productivity suite vendor's generative AI add-on (vendor-hosted large language model in the business tenant); no custom model; vendor terms exclude training on customer prompts and files
data_categories: Prompts and anything the owner's account can open: all four entities' mail and files, including (until moved) rental applications with SSNs, screening reports, driver license scans, and new-hire forms
affects_individuals: Yes (tenants, applicants, customers, and staff receive drafted messages or have data the assistant can surface)
consequential_decision_category: None as approved (use in Housing or Employment decisions is prohibited by POL-01 9.5; the 2026-07-14 unit 4B use was a Housing use and was High)
human_in_the_loop: Owner reads and checks every output before it is sent or saved; listings read against 42 U.S.C. 3604(c); monthly check of prompt history for Restricted data; agent features off
applicable_laws: 42 U.S.C. 3604 and 15 U.S.C. 1681b(f), 1681m(a) (Rentals); 16 CFR 682.3 (Rentals); Fla. Stat. 501.171(2) (each LLC)
status: In production (owner only, since 2026-06-01); approved with 3 conditions 2026-08-31, due 2026-09-30

use_case: Tenant screening recommendation (accept, decline, or conditional) shown with each screening report in the property management platform (SYS-06)
vendor_or_model: Consumer reporting agency partner of the property management platform (vendor scoring; method not disclosed to the owner)
data_categories: Applicant identity, credit, and eviction history information (consumer reports)
human_in_the_loop: Owner decides every application against written selection criteria (2026-07-30); the recommendation is one input, never the decision; adverse action notice through the platform when a report contributes
status: In production; owner to obtain the vendor's description of the recommendation basis by 2026-11-30
